skid.description: Skids in from the left, past its place and back.

pivot.description: Swings up about its lower left corner.

swing.description: Swings into place from its top middle, as a sign hangs; as emphasis, sways.

flip.description: Turns in about its middle, as a card flips.

draw.description: A shape's outline draws on from where it starts.

blink.description: Emphasis: dims once, quickly, and comes back.

jiggle.description: Emphasis: a quick wobble that settles.
